scenarios.title: One market fill + one purchase + one physical consumption never double count
steps: Complete native corporate sale with Rust fill and wallet ledger IDs
Physically debit same ammo in a native fire-cycle
Advance A-Life and native demand observation
expected: Seller target is not boosted by transfer receipts
Only real ammo debit boosts consumption forecast once
All stack and ISK balances conserve

scenarios.title: Unfilled ask does not starve a second product
steps: List product A and leave ask open
Introduce real shortage of product B at same NPC station
Advance one shared factory director
expected: Product A remains in escrow unchanged
Product B obtains exactly one PREPARED native job
No additional sale/escrow/wallet entry for product A

scenarios.title: Real PAUSED to RESUMED production
steps: Install native job and confirm first debit
PAUSE status 2 for multiple scheduler ticks
Resume and wait for native timer
expected: No duplicate install while status 2
One READY and one physical delivery after resume
Original blueprint installed custody at 2003 preserved

scenarios.title: Duplicate native consumption notifications do not grow production
steps: Fire one verified NPC weapon shot
Replay identical native debit under different telemetry receiptIDs
Attempt second restock
expected: Duplicate consumptionID fails closed
No second paid job or stock mint
Operator blocker contains canonical native debit ID

scenarios.title: Aged demand decays without synthetic buys
steps: Consume finite verified physical ammo
Advance isolated native clock beyond 24h
No new buys or weapon uses
expected: Forecast returns to configured base target
Old market fills never multiply demand
No idle infinite manufacturing

scenarios.title: Two NPC corporations cannot share receipts
steps: Place two corporations in same station and product type
Give native ammo consumption only to owner A
Advance demand and native planning for owner B
expected: B's stock target remains unchanged
A's debit is never reused by B
No cross-corporation ISK or item transfer

scenarios.title: Multiple passive Rust asks rotate without blocking active work
steps: Establish several separately verified corporate sell orders
Keep buyers absent and advance many ticks
Introduce shortage on independent product
expected: All passive asks remain reconciled to native escrow
Polling rotates between asks
New valid production proceeds under capacity limits

scenarios.title: Restart and lost ACK conserve passive orders
steps: List a native product and let another product start
Restart GameStore, Rust and native director between transitions
Inject lost native settlement ACK and retry
expected: No duplicate Rust order, item or ISK credits
Unknown outcomes block unsafe retries
All existing orders and jobs retain owner/station identity
